title: Handoff Tool Contracts
description: Structural tools for transferring a case to a specialist agent. These tools are not approval-gated — the agent's decision to hand off is itself the governed action.

trigger_agent_handoff.description: Transfer the current case to a specialist agent. Use when the case requires expertise outside your domain. The structured facts you provide are the only context the receiving agent will have — be thorough and specific.

to_agent.description: The specialist agent to hand off to.

reason.description: Why this case requires the specialist agent. Shown to the user.

structured_facts.description: Key facts gathered so far — employee data, findings, anomalies, relevant figures.

uncertainty_statement.description: What is still unknown or unresolved about the case.
